name: @ocs/parity
//: Parity: the bit, the frame it travels in, and the overlapping-bit codes that locate an error rather than only noticing one. A separate family from @ocs/checksum because a parity bit is not arithmetic over a message -- it is one bit of a single unit, interleaved with the data rather than appended to it, and it lives in the wire format. See the note on ToolFamily. `./manifests` is eager and dependency-free; `./definition` is the on-demand half that reaches @ocs/algos.
